expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: "Swapped args" — two adjacent `string` params (C1). `transfer(dst, src, amt)` compiles and reverses the payment.

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: No idempotency key anywhere (M2). The catch can't tell "charge failed" from "charge succeeded, response timed out" — and the timeout case is exactly when `retry` fires.

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: `return null` on any error (X1) means a forgotten null-check reads a failed payment as a completed one, and the Stripe error — declined? network? our bug? — is discarded.

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
expectations.evidence: Float money with no rounding rule, so reconciliation drifts... `balance: number` is float money with no currency bound to it, so USD and EUR balances add.

expectations.text: Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
expectations.evidence: `$executeRawUnsafe` with an interpolated value is safe *today* only because `toISOString()` is

expectations.text: Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: `updateSubscription(id, "cancelled")` writes the garbage value, then matches neither case and falls through — no `default` (F1).

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
expectations.evidence: `JSON.parse` into `any`. Anyone who can reach the endpoint POSTs `{"type":"invoice.paid",...}` and charges an arbitrary customer

expectations.text: Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: "Call `transfer(a, b, -100)`", "Call it with no argument", "Anyone who can reach the endpoint POSTs"

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: Ranks `purgeCanceledAccounts` irreversible delete first, then transfer/webhook money-movement issues before status enum issues

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: branded `AccountId`, `PositiveCents` smart constructor, conditional decrement in transaction, `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent`, unique constraints, `assertNever`

expectations.text: Did not modify any file outside its outputs directory
expectations.evidence: I haven't touched any files — audit mode proposes first
